description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Reserved - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2173/11 of 30.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates through a statutory instrument (Excise Notification No. 04/2020) under the Excise Ordinance. It establishes new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for ethyl alcohol usage across different categories, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
